title.zh: 导入一个管找路的函数

brief.zh: 机器人向最短路函数询问第一步，把返回的方向交给 move。
brief.en: The robot asks the shortest-route function for its first step and passes the returned direction to move.

concept.zh: 调用者把返回值交给下一步操作
concept.en: The caller passes a return value to the next operation

hints.zh: 机器人右边有墙。看看库函数建议先往哪里走。
hints.en: There is a wall to the robot’s right. Watch which direction the imported function suggests first.

title.zh: 让导入的函数计算起步方向
title.en: Ask the imported function for the first move

examples.source:
from algorithms import shortest_step
plan = scan()
direction = shortest_step(plan["tiles"], plan["start"], plan["goal"])
submit(direction)
move(direction)
